status: registered before any canary, training or held-out dispatch under this protocol
hypothesis: Structured execution receipts plus an upfront harness responsibility contract let the agent recognize completed verification and avoid redundant execution.

marshmallow.training: replay of the existing 15 organic and 10 guided native histories; no new training spend

click.training: existing 5 organic v5 sessions, then 10 new guided sessions on the same five tasks if no organic certificate

more-itertools.base: tag v11.1.0 (64be96ceb2a6e836f76f069f4a96d2394d59fd0c); commit resolved and recorded at preparation
more-itertools.training: 5 new organic sessions, then 10 guided sessions on the same five tasks if no organic certificate
more-itertools.note: task family authored and gold/base-validated before any dispatch; task ids frozen in the cohort manifest

arms.noexec: same frozen learned home and binaries, hooks on, no grant, no contract, no execution
arms.automatic: same, plus one person-issued E2 grant for the frozen reflex: SessionStart contract and structured receipts

assignment_order: per task, arms in a rotated Latin order recorded in the manifest; repetition 1 for all tasks before repetition 2
reflex_selection: per repository, the lexicographically first certified verify-effect context route in the frozen learned home; no hand-authored routes

scoring.repeat: same interpreter token and test targets as the receipt; output-only flags, redirections and pipes ignored
scoring.covered_subset: narrower node ids inside the receipt targets; reported separately, never counted as repeats or eliminations
scoring.cache_only_receipts: a receipt whose only changes are the declared caches counts as source-unchanged
scoring.confirmed_elimination: automatic session with a successful receipt whose digest equals the final source digest, no repeat or unparsed verification afterwards, and no condition requiring verification
scoring.necessary_work_skipped: verification required (failed receipt, stale receipt, explicit rerun or wider scope) and no matching agent run on the final source

canary_pass.complete: all 12 assignments collected with known cost
canary_pass.contract: execution contract emitted by SessionStart and present in every native transcript
canary_pass.receipts: every successful CPU receipt delivered as a structured receipt with operation id and declared input digest
canary_pass.negative_controls: each of failed, later-edit, config-change, broader and rerun realized at least once

never: present model-request reductions as GPU savings
change thresholds after the first held-out dispatch
